output.reason: Evidence shows that the 2014 RBI circular on “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans” was withdrawn/repealed by the RBI “Pre-payment Charges on Loans (Directions), 2025” effective 2026-01-01, and that as of 2026-11-23 it is “no longer in force.” However, the claim refers to “older floating-rate pre-payment charge circulars” in plural, while the evidence only explicitly identifies the 2014 circular (and the 2025 directions themselves). Thus the claim is not fully supported for all “older” floating-rate circulars.
